The integrated witnesses preserve deferred and future candidates through modeled retention loss, separate snapshot availability, WELCOME audit advancement, RESET installation and continued delivery; physical retention and snapshot authenticity remain unproven.

Logical Stop remains enabled across the declared finite queues and recovery phases and completes under named weak fairness; execution fencing, physical termination, parser rejection and data-delivery liveness are not established.

observed: Local execution of finite models and literal oracle controls only. No provider calls or product support measurement.
limitations: Four source identities and grants; mixed fixed payload costs and selected queue bounds; no cutoff theorem.

Both concrete definitions checked by exact local correspondence over the reachable split/audit product; stronger than visible trace inclusion and not separate performance measurements.
